presentation.label: Nosebleed
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us about the nosebleed: when it started, which side, how much blood you've lost, and anything you've tried to stop it.

questions.question: Is the bleeding still continuing now, despite pinching the soft part of your nose firmly for 10-15 minutes?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the nosebleed is still actively bleeding despite firm pressure for 10-15 minutes?

questions.question: Have you felt dizzy, lightheaded, or faint during this episode?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has felt dizzy, lightheaded, or faint during this nosebleed?

questions.question: Did this nosebleed follow a blow or injury to the face or nose?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the nosebleed followed a facial or nasal injury?

questions.question: Are you taking any blood-thinning medication, such as warfarin, apixaban, rivaroxaban, clopidogrel, or aspirin?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient is taking blood-thinning medication such as warfarin, apixaban, rivaroxaban, clopidogrel, or aspirin?

questions.question: Do you have a known bleeding or clotting disorder, or have you noticed unusual bruising or bleeding from your gums elsewhere on your body?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate a known bleeding or clotting disorder, or unusual bruising or bleeding elsewhere on the body?

questions.question: How many separate nosebleeds have you had in the past month?
questions.range_warning_text: That's a lot of nosebleeds in a month - please double check this number.

questions.question: Which side is the nosebleed on, and does blood ever run down the back of your throat?
Do you have high blood pressure that is not well controlled?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has high blood pressure that is not well controlled?

ent_epistaxis_active_bleeding_urgent.message: A nosebleed that will not stop after 10-15 minutes of firm pressure needs urgent assessment. Call 999 or go to A&E instead of sending an online form.

ent_epistaxis_shock_urgent.message: Feeling dizzy, lightheaded, or faint with a nosebleed can be a sign of significant blood loss and needs urgent assessment. Call 999 or go to A&E instead of sending an online form.

ent_epistaxis_trauma_urgent.message: A nosebleed following a facial or nasal injury needs urgent assessment. Call 999 or go to A&E instead of sending an online form.

ent_epistaxis_anticoagulant_urgent.message: A nosebleed while taking blood-thinning medication needs prompt assessment. Call the surgery and ask to speak to the duty doctor instead of sending an online form.

ent_epistaxis_bleeding_disorder_urgent.message: A nosebleed with a known bleeding disorder, or alongside unusual bruising or bleeding elsewhere, needs prompt assessment. Call the surgery and ask to speak to the duty doctor instead of sending an online form.
